main: Per-goal, native same visible N. Preserve P2-18 originals and frozen A3 ordering in S0 for carried goals, rerun its unchanged engine for new goals. U(n) uses the preserved P2-18 phase and selector from a count-only manifest.
suitability: Separate public intent, observation role, source root and when/where the candidate differs from an existing witness. Enumerate all D1–D6 reasons. Select a representative for each relevant supported role and time region, by within-dimension priority, source comparability and temporal relation. No predefined total or per-dimension slots. A public single-view goal naturally permits one direct image, with remaining observations discoverable. No global adequacy claim.
D6: Independent runs of D6-only nominations remain searchable even when other dimensions are active. A temporally scoped goal can receive a checkable temporal witness only when the applicable run has actual pixel change evidence. Use its internal median source time and retain all other members in metadata. A public late-only or single-view goal does not automatically request an early temporal contrast.
groups: S2 uses S1 entries plus a directly measured A/C bracket with genuine source timestamps or D5 comparison witnesses. One measured comparison per role and interval of the observed time partitions, preserving alternatives in the log. Sample the full applicable bracket by the original 8 Hz clock. Prefer a distinct observed state or closest useful earlier-state confirmation; keep rival explanations and unresolved range. S3 uses S2 and additional automatic weak words only for opened exploration, with a spatially registered nomination required to open an uncovered time region. Candidate text is not displayed in observer payloads.
quality: The transport and archive are never compressed or pruned. Pending catalog metadata has no count limitation. All delivered images are original independent PNG, count repeated visible sends. The reviewer labels frozen role-window supports, known noncontributing or role-redundant examples, and unjudged for other images. No claim of global completeness, physical continuity, contact or identity.
E0: Separate evaluator uses source frame PTS, library/pool availability and independently viewed source reference images. Full-catalog enumeration is a separate diagnostic. Use frozen references unchanged; expand crossed intents and independent holdout before prediction. Candidate thresholds and phase cannot be adapted to E0 outcomes.
observer: Existing local session/prompt adapter and native RGB audit. Model understanding is out of scoring scope. No real SDK invocation is required by the task card.
